description: This file defines a custom adapter class `SpeedPickerListAdapter` used to populate a list of speed options in an Android Wearable application. It extends `WearableListView.Adapter` and manages creating and binding list item views displaying different speeds.

classes.name: SpeedPickerListAdapter
classes.description: A custom adapter for WearableListView that displays a list of speed options.

classes.name: ItemViewHolder
classes.description: A ViewHolder class that holds references to the views in each list item, specifically a TextView showing the speed.

methods.name: SpeedPickerListAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with a context and a dataset of speed values.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and inflates a new view for a list item.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the view for a given position in the list.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of items in the dataset.
